decks.notes: The deck revolves around quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back onto the battlefield for a quick win. It also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo. The deck utilizes a mix of traditional reanimation targets like Archon of Cruelty and innovative choices like Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The inclusion of cards like Animate Dead and Undercity Sewers provide flexibility and additional reanimation options. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful reanimation spells like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while controlling the game with counterspells and removal spells. It also utilizes card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the necessary combo pieces.

The primary focus of this deck is to utilize a combination of spells and creatures to quickly mill through the library and set up a win condition using Thassa's Oracle. By playing cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to accelerate its game plan and cast combo pieces such as Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill the library. The inclusion of cards like Pact of Negation and Cabal Therapy provides protection and disruption to help the deck execute its combo efficiently.

The focus of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Mystic Forge in conjunction with various artifact cards like Glaring Fleshraker, Karn, the Great Creator, and Urza's Saga to generate advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using mana acceleration cards and key artifacts like Voltaic Key and Manifold Key, the deck aims to assemble a powerful board state and control the game through efficient card selection and activation. The synergy between artifacts and the Mystic Forge is central to the deck's strategy, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming advantage.

This deck aims to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Murktide Regent. The deck also includes card selection and manipulation tools like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to ensure consistency. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and efficient threats, this deck seeks to maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan in order to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly using cards like Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, and Lion's Eye Diamond to cast a powerful spell like Ad Nauseam or Tendrils of Agony to win the game in one explosive turn. The deck also includes cards like Duress and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own combo. Burning Wish allows for additional flexibility and access to sideboard cards. The main strategy is to set up the combo pieces, generate mana, and win the game in a single explosive turn.

This deck focuses on quickly and efficiently putting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. It also uses counterspells and disruption like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces. The deck includes various creatures with powerful abilities like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to close out the game. Additionally, it includes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder for card selection and filtering. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its fast and resilient reanimation strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bring them back onto the battlefield for a fast and lethal combination. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces and disruption like Brazen Borrower and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board. The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifacts and mana ramp to quickly assemble a combo with Mystic Forge, Voltaic Key, and other key pieces like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to generate significant card advantage and mana efficiency to overwhelm the opponent and create a powerful board presence. The inclusion of control elements like Pithing Needle and Vexing Bauble allow for disruption and protection while leveraging the artifact synergy. The deck's strategy is focused on fast combo execution and resource management to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

This deck aims to quickly and efficiently combo off by utilizing a high density of fast mana sources, free creatures, and various combo pieces. The deck is built around explosive starts and seeks to win the game before the opponent has a chance to react, focusing on a high-risk, high-reward strategy that can lead to fast and decisive victories.
